//: THE INSTITUTE — the Imperium's opening (docs/ACADEMY.md). You are Cassian Thorne, sixteen, the orphaned heir of a knightly house, sent to the Institute: a year of war between the Standards before the Imperial court ever sees you. The world is the Imperial Court's, ten years earlier in Cassian's life: unmarried, untried, bottom of every ladder.

houses.name: House Thorne
houses.title: knight
houses.//: A knightly house holding one fief at the Emperor's sufferance. Legitimate for its rung (Knight needs 10) but nothing above it — every climb must be granted, bought, or married.

houses.name: House Aurelian
houses.title: emperor
houses.//: The Imperial house. The throne, and the favor that flows from it, is the one currency that matters here.

houses.name: House Valmont
houses.title: duke
houses.//: The great house of the court: a Dukedom, a forge-world, and open contempt for knights who climb.

characters.name: Cassian Thorne
characters.//: The knight's heir at sixteen: nothing yet but a name the great houses do not use.

characters.name: Octavian Aurelian
characters.//: The Emperor: old, just, proud, and at mortality age — his death is the succession that will reshape the court. Binds to sovereign roles (title emperor, outranks everyone).

characters.name: Livia Aurelian
characters.//: The heir who will not wait. Outranks Cassian; could be patron or nemesis.

characters.name: Marius Valmont
characters.//: The Imperial Minister — a Duke's power and a miser's soul. The contempt-for-the-risen antagonist; binds to superior/rival_minister/collector roles.

relationships.//: A loyal subject, hoping to be noticed.
The Emperor has heard the name. Barely.
A knight's whelp with a lawyer's tongue. Contempt.
Open: a useful tool, or an obstacle.

holdings.name: Lesser Marrow
holdings.//: One fief, held at pleasure. Feeds the household and little else.

holdings.name: Aurelia Prime
holdings.//: The throne-world. Abstracted (GDD §3): one holding stands in for an empire.

fleets.name: The Imperial Home Fleet
fleets.//: An OFFICE fleet (GDD §8): the Emperor commands it by the throne, not by blood.
